regulatory_bodies: BAuA (Federal Institute for Occupational Safety and Health)

rules.name: VerpackG Mandatory Registration in the LUCID Register & Dual System
rules.title: VerpackG Mandatory Registration in the LUCID Register & Dual System
rules.expected_requirement: Every manufacturer or cross-border online seller shipping packaged goods to German consumers must be registered in the public LUCID register and participate in a dual system for packaging waste recycling.
rules.explanation: Non-registered sellers face a nationwide sales ban on all marketplaces (Amazon, eBay), fines up to €200,000, and marketplace account suspensions under VerpackG § 34.
rules.fix_suggestion: Register on the ZSVR LUCID portal, obtain a registration number, and contract with an accredited German dual system (e.g., Interseroh, Der Grüne Punkt).

rules.name: ElektroG Mandatory WEEE Registration with Stiftung EAR
rules.title: ElektroG Mandatory WEEE Registration with Stiftung EAR
rules.expected_requirement: Producers and cross-border sellers of electronic appliances must register with Stiftung EAR and obtain a WEEE registration number before offering electrical goods in Germany.
rules.explanation: Offering electronic devices without Stiftung EAR registration constitutes an administrative offence under ElektroG and results in instant marketplace delisting and customs confiscation.
rules.fix_suggestion: Appoint an authorized representative in Germany and secure a Stiftung EAR WEEE registration number.

rules.name: ProdSG § 6 Mandatory German Language Safety Instructions
rules.title: ProdSG § 6 Mandatory German Language Safety Instructions
rules.expected_requirement: Consumer products must have operating instructions, safety warnings, and contact details of the EU manufacturer/importer in the German language.
rules.explanation: Products distributed in Germany with English-only safety warnings fail ProdSG requirements and are blocked by German market surveillance authorities.
rules.fix_suggestion: Provide accurate German translations for all operating manuals, safety warnings, and dosage directions.

requirements.name: German Language Safety Instructions
requirements.description: German text for warnings and manuals.

rules.name: LFGB §§ 30/31 Food Contact Safety & German Knife-and-Fork Conformity
rules.title: LFGB §§ 30/31 Food Contact Safety & German Knife-and-Fork Conformity
rules.expected_requirement: Food contact articles must satisfy LFGB testing, proving no toxic migration of sensory substances, heavy metals, or volatile organic compounds into food.
rules.explanation: German customs and trade inspectors routinely test bamboo and wooden cutting boards for formaldehyde and PCP migration. Non-compliant items receive instant import bans.
rules.fix_suggestion: Provide LFGB accredited laboratory test report according to BfR Recommendations for food contact materials.

rules.name: Heilmittelwerbegesetz (HWG) § 3 Strict Advertising Restrictions
rules.title: Heilmittelwerbegesetz (HWG) § 3 Strict Advertising Restrictions
rules.directive_code: Heilmittelwerbegesetz (HWG) § 3 / Gesetz gegen den unlauteren Wettbewerb (UWG)
rules.statute_citation: Heilmittelwerbegesetz (HWG) § 3 / Gesetz gegen den unlauteren Wettbewerb (UWG)
rules.expected_requirement: Strict ban on misleading health claims, cure promises, or disease relief advertising for non-prescription consumer products.
rules.explanation: Promising that a cosmetic cream 'heals arthritis' violates HWG § 3, exposing the seller to competitor cease-and-desist warnings (Abmahnung) with legal costs.
rules.fix_suggestion: Replace disease cure claims with cosmetic structure/function soothing descriptions.

rules.name: Batteriegesetz (BattG) Battery Register Notification
rules.title: Batteriegesetz (BattG) Battery Register Notification
rules.expected_requirement: Producers and importers of batteries must be registered with Stiftung EAR and participate in a battery take-back scheme.
rules.explanation: Distributing rechargeable battery wands in Germany without BattG registration triggers immediate marketplace sanctions.
rules.fix_suggestion: Register battery models on the Stiftung EAR portal and contract with a recognized battery disposal system.
